thread:
Aisha: Heads-up — planning a canary for release v2.4.1 today 15:30 PT. Three cohorts: internal (5%), beta customers (15%), public (40%). Rolling window ~45m. Need clear owners for deploy, smoke, and rollback readiness. @Ben you able to run the deploy?

Ben: I can take the deploy. Will kick off at ~15:32 PT and watch the dashboards. Plan: 5% -> 15% -> 40% with quick checks in-between. Deploy command I’ll use: `./deploy/canary.sh --release v2.4.1 --cohorts 5,15,40`

deploy-bot: Pipeline queued: `release/v2.4.1` -> canary (CI: ✅ all checks passed).

Carla: I’ll own smoke checks for each cohort. Checklist I’ll run: 1) 99th latency < 500ms, 2) error rate < 0.5%, 3) no new 5xx types, 4) sample LLM outputs sanity check. I’ll add short notes per step.

Dmitri: Rollback plan: tag `rollback/v2.4.1` is ready. Manual backout steps in infra playbook: `infra/playbooks/backout.md`. Quick command if needed: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-server --to-revision=<rev>` and shift traffic to fallback pool.

Erin: I’ll monitor traces/logs and alert on any token-cost anomalies or timeout spikes. If anything odd, I’ll DM infra oncall and ping here.

Ben: Preparing cluster now, will run a local smoke before first cohort. ETA start in ~5m.

Aisha: Timeline we’re syncing on: T0 start, T+10m evaluate -> ramp to 15% if green, T+30m evaluate -> ramp to 40% if green. Abort conditions: sustained 20%+ latency increase or error rate >0.5% for 5m. Everyone good with those gates?

Carla: Sounds good. I’ll mark each gate with :white_check_mark: or :x: in this thread.

Ben: Kicking off deploy now — CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/12345 (canary job).

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2026-03-17T22:32:00Z — release/v2.4.1 (canary cohort: internal 5%).

Erin: Initial metrics look OK: p50/p95/p99 within baseline, error rate 0.1%. Watching traces for regressions.

Carla: Internal cohort smoke: PASS :white_check_mark:. Sample output sanity:
```
> User: Summarize the quarterly ops notes
> Model: Summary looks coherent; no hallucinations detected in sample.
```

Dmitri: Infra looks stable from my end. Reminder: if we need to throttle, endpoint to shift is `/ops/traffic-shift --to=dik-dedicated` (ops script).

Ben: Ramping to 15% in ~3m. Will post update when ramp completes.

Aisha: Thanks all — if we hit abort Ben you run the rollback and shout in #incidents. If stable we continue to 40% and aim for full rollout tomorrow morning.

Ben: Copy that. I’ll post final status after the 15% window.
